stem:
A student investigates an electrical circuit.

The circuit is set up as shown in Fig. 2.1.

[[fig:f1]]

A battery of negligible internal resistance is connected to a resistor of resistance *Z*. Five resistors, each of resistance *R*, are connected in parallel between P and Q.

The switch is closed. The total current *I* in the circuit is measured using the ammeter.

The experiment is then repeated by changing the number *n* of resistors, each of resistance *R*, connected in parallel between P and Q.

It is suggested that *I* and *n* are related by the equation

$E = I\left(\frac{R}{n} + Z\right)$

where *E* is the electromotive force (e.m.f.) of the battery.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
A graph is plotted of $\frac{1}{I}$ on the y-axis against $\frac{1}{n}$ on the x-axis.

Determine expressions for the gradient and y-intercept.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Values of *n*, $\frac{1}{n}$ and *I* are given in Table 2.1.

[[fig:f2]]

Calculate and record values of $\frac{1}{I}/10^3\,\mathrm{A}^{-1}$ in Table 2.1. Include the absolute uncertainties in $\frac{1}{I}$.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: Plot a graph of $\frac{1}{I}/10^3\,\mathrm{A}^{-1}$ against $\frac{1}{n}$. Include error bars for $\frac{1}{I}$.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Draw the straight line of best fit and a worst acceptable straight line on your graph. Label both lines.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text:
Determine the gradient of the line of best fit. Include the absolute uncertainty in your answer.

[[fig:f3]]

parts.label: (c)(iv)
parts.text: Determine the y-intercept of the line of best fit. Include the absolute uncertainty in your answer.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.lead: The e.m.f. *E* of the battery is determined twice during the experiment. The values obtained are 5.6V and 6.0V.
parts.text: Using your answers to (a), (c)(iii) and (c)(iv), determine the values of *R* and *Z*. Include appropriate units.

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text: Determine the percentage uncertainty in your value of *R*.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text: The experiment is repeated with 20 resistors, each of resistance *R*, connected in parallel between P and Q. Determine the total current *I* in the circuit.

figures.alt: An electrical circuit with a battery, switch, ammeter, resistor Z and five parallel resistors between P and Q.

figures.caption: Table 2.1
